spec.title: Lunch rush inside the building
spec.question: Where do people get stuck moving through this building at lunchtime, and which change helps most?
spec.context: Weekday lunchtime at Synthetic office and retail building. People are moving between the offices upstairs, the café and the market downstairs.

minds.name: Maya Okafor
minds.about: Product manager on the second floor with back-to-back meetings
minds.wants: a quick lunch she can eat at her desk

minds.name: Derek Lin
minds.about: Accountant who takes a proper lunch break every day

minds.name: Sana Iqbal
minds.wants: to try the café everyone mentions

minds.name: Tom Becker
minds.about: Facilities manager who knows every corner of the building
minds.wants: to be back before his 1 pm call

minds.name: Lucia Ortega
minds.about: Nurse from the clinic across the street on a 30-minute break

minds.name: Priya Shah
minds.about: Parent picking up groceries between errands

minds.name: Walt Hughes
minds.about: Regular who shops here three times a week
minds.wants: his usual items and a chat at checkout

minds.name: Nina Petrova
minds.about: Office worker from next door on a snack run

minds.name: Omar Haddad
minds.about: Client arriving for a 12:30 meeting upstairs
minds.wants: to sign in and find the meeting room

minds.name: Kevin Tran
minds.about: Food delivery courier on a tight schedule
minds.wants: to drop off and get to the next order
